correctness.rationale: Odd n admits an alternating-sign eigenvector of eigenvalue -1, and for even n diagonal sign-conjugacy flips U to -U. Young’s coordinate inequality yields an exact minimum of edge defects E_p(a,b) around the antiperiodic ring, positive for any nonzero even periodic vector. The nonlinear power map sign(a)|a|^{p/2} converts the defect into a coercive square of adjacent transformed differences. Its local positive ratio is c_p=2(p-1)/p^2, while global compact normalized-pair bounds handle sign changes and zeros. A minimizing sequence’s anti-periodic piecewise-linear interpolants have bounded H1 norms and L2 mass 1; localization away from zeros and weak lower semicontinuity yield liminf c_p∫|z’|²≥c_p pi² by the antiperiodic Poincaré inequality. A positive sine recovery vector gives equality in the limit; p=2 reduces to cos(pi/n). Finite verification script was read but does not establish the infinite limit.
